headline: Woman dies after mugger yanks her from rickshaw in Dhaka
summary: Soheli Islam Soma, a 42-year-old pharmaceutical sales officer, succumbed to head injuries after being flung onto the road during a bag-snatching incident.
details: Soheli Islam Soma, 42, died on Thursday morning while undergoing treatment at Anwar Khan Modern Hospital.
The incident occurred on June 6 when Soma was returning home with her daughter in an autorickshaw after visiting family in Dinajpur's Parbatipur for the Eid holiday.
As they passed near Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, motorcycle-riding muggers grabbed her handbag and pulled it with such force that she was flung from the rickshaw.
Soma struck her head on a divider, resulting in critical injuries. She was admitted to the hospital in critical condition immediately after the attack.
Her body was later taken to her maternal grandparents' home in Pabna's Ishurdi for burial.
Despite the tragedy, her family has not yet filed a formal police complaint. No postmortem was conducted on the victim.
Police officials from Mohammadpur and Sher-e-Bangla Nagar stations, as well as Parbatipur Police, stated they are unaware of any formal case being filed regarding the incident.
caption:
A woman was flung from a rickshaw and killed after muggers snatched her bag in Dhaka.

Soheli Islam Soma, 42, died on Thursday morning while undergoing treatment at Anwar Khan Modern Hospital.

The incident occurred on June 6 when Soma was returning home with her daughter in an autorickshaw after visiting family in Dinajpur's Parbatipur for the Eid holiday.

As they passed near Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, motorcycle-riding muggers grabbed her handbag and pulled it with such force that she was flung from the rickshaw.

Soma struck her head on a divider, resulting in critical injuries. She was admitted to the hospital in critical condition immediately after the attack.

Her body was later taken to her maternal grandparents' home in Pabna's Ishurdi for burial.

Despite the tragedy, her family has not yet filed a formal police complaint. No postmortem was conducted on the victim.

Police officials from Mohammadpur and Sher-e-Bangla Nagar stations, as well as Parbatipur Police, stated they are unaware of any formal case being filed regarding the incident.

Source: bdnews24.com, Dhaka Tribune
